RatioValue.description:
A ratio (SPEC-0007 R3, R7). When it is not defined or not computed, its value is null and
the reason is an entry of `diagnostics.not_computed` at the ratio's pointer (SPEC-0012 R6).

value.description:
The ratio, in the unit stated by the field that holds it (decimal fraction, multiple or
days); null when the ratio is not defined or not computed (see
`diagnostics.not_computed`).

dscr.description:
CFADS / debt service of each period, multiple, in the order of the schedule; empty when
no debt schedule is given.

llcr.description: (Present value of CFADS + reserve balance) / debt outstanding, multiple.

net_financial_position.description:
Net financial position used by the ratios, in currency units (positive for net debt);
null when not computed.

pv_cfads.description:
Present value of the CFADS of every period at the calculation date, in currency units;
null when no debt schedule is given or when it is not computed.
